title: The "good" Boussinesq equation on the half-line with Robin boundary conditions
summary: We prove the local Hadamard well-posedness of the ``good'' Boussinesq equation formulated on the half-line with nonzero Robin boundary conditions. These boundary data involve the Dirichlet and Neumann boundary values as well as the second spatial derivative of the solution evaluated at the boundary. The nonlinear analysis crucially relies on the linear estimates established through the explicit solution formula obtained for the forced linear counterpart of the problem via Fokas's unified transform.
